name: Ozark Howler
description: A regional cryptid of the Ozark Mountains of Arkansas and Missouri, described as a stocky, bear-sized animal with a shaggy black coat, glowing eyes, prominent horns, and a distinctive howling cry.

aliases.name: Hoo-Hoo
aliases.meaning: Onomatopoeic name from the creature's reported call

origin: Reports concentrate in the Ozark Mountains of northern Arkansas and southern Missouri, with occasional reports from adjacent Oklahoma and eastern Texas.
